prerequisites: Competencies taught in the 'Grundlagen der Linearen Algebra' module are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know basic knowledge in analysis.
Students understand the concept of a limit in sequences, series, functions, and power series.
Students can recognize cross-connections to their own discipline.
Students can apply mathematical and especially analytical ways of thinking and working to concrete questions, including technically motivated problems.
Students have a mathematical intuition and can translate it into precise concepts and formal justifications.
Students can discuss analysis content in a structured manner within a group.

syllabus_topics: Fundamentals of logic and set theory
Properties of sequences and series, limits
Intermediate Value Theorem, Extreme Value Theorem
Mean Value Theorem of differential calculus
assessment_rules: To acquire credits, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises must be achieved. Grading is based on a written exam with 0 to 15 points, according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program.
